claims.boundary: Practice principles and questions families can ask. The AAP does not endorse Pinnacle.

claims.pageStatement: Abilities, goals, appropriate supports, everyday practice and review are connected to a direction toward growing self-sufficiency and participation.
claims.boundary: Pinnacle programme description. It does not guarantee independence, school entry, inclusion or an individual outcome.
